_comment: SYNTHETIC MINIMUM NETWORK — producer arm, 3 solve stations + 1 held-out consumer.
docs/SPEC_synthetic_minimum_network.md.  SMOKE: 20 epochs, wiring validation only.
INT posture (SPEC §2.2): the sim leaves corrections.signal_bias OFF, so
enable_code_phase_bias MUST be false here or the producer would remove an OSB the
data never carried.  The two flip together; the W6 arm flips both the other way.
EVERY OTHER model_corrections flag is matched to the sim's injected stack.  The sim
injects by REUSING the processor's own models, so a matched pair cancels exactly and
a MISmatched one is a systematic that looks like an estimator defect.
GPS-only via active_systems.  The synthetic RINEX carries Galileo too (the sim's
signal plan is fixed), so this is a producer-side restriction, not a data property —
which also means a GPS+Gal arm needs no new data.
processing.signal_priorities is MANDATORY and not merely conventional: with the key
absent, selectObservationTypes returns an empty vector for the missing constellation
and EVERY station contributes ZERO observations, with no error (SPEC §2.3).
